note: English text for the demo meals, applied by data/build/build_demo_meals.py after the word edits. Keyed by the slug of the saved meal's original title. Whole fields: title (recipe.title), idea_name (picked_idea.name), one_line (picked_idea.one_line), steps (recipe.steps, same number of steps and the same numbers in each step). words: [old, new] pairs applied in order to every step and to one_line, for Spanish food words inside English text. Grams, units and quantities never change here.

bol-de-pavo-picado-con-boniato-y-espinac.title: Ground turkey bowl with sweet potato and spinach
bol-de-pavo-picado-con-boniato-y-espinac.idea_name: Roasted turkey with sweet potato and spinach
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 2 cm cubes.
Toss the sweet potato with the paprika and a pinch of salt. Bake 25 minutes on baking paper, turning it halfway through.
Finely chop the garlic. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat, with no oil.
Add the ground turkey with salt. Cook it 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and no longer pink.
Add the garlic and cook 1 more minute. Lower the heat to medium.
Beat the 3 eggs in a glass with a pinch of salt. Pour them over the turkey and stir 2 minutes until set.
Put the fresh spinach in the pan and stir 1 minute until it wilts. Take the pan off the heat.
Divide the turkey with egg and spinach into 3 bowls and add the roasted sweet potato on top.
Store in containers. Reheat the bowl in the microwave for 2 minutes at work.
bol-de-pavo-picado-con-boniato-y-espinac.craving: Ground turkey bowl with sweet potato.

bol-de-pechuga-con-arroz-y-verduras.title: Chicken breast bowl with rice and vegetables
bol-de-pechuga-con-arroz-y-verduras.idea_name: Chicken breast bowl with rice and vegetables
bol-de-pechuga-con-arroz-y-verduras.one_line: Cooked chicken breast with rice, a fresh salad of cucumber, cherry tomato, red pepper and avocado, and a quark dressing
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees. Season the chicken breasts with paprika, oregano, salt and pepper.
Bake the chicken 20 to 25 minutes until it is cooked through. Let it cool a little and cut it into strips.
Cook the rice in salted water for about 12 minutes. Drain it and let it cool.
Mix the quark with a pinch of salt, pepper and oregano to make the dressing.
Wash the cucumber, the red pepper and the cherry tomatoes. Cut the cucumber and the pepper into pieces and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Divide the chicken and the rice into 8 containers. Keep the vegetables and the dressing apart.
Each day, cut the fresh avocado and add it with the vegetables and the dressing just before eating. The chicken and rice can be heated in the microwave.
bol-de-pechuga-con-arroz-y-verduras.craving: Chicken bowl for the week with fresh vegetables: cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red bell pepper and avocado, with a whipped quark dressing.

ensalada-de-atun-y-garbanzos-con-alino-d.title: Tuna and chickpea salad with skyr dressing
ensalada-de-atun-y-garbanzos-con-alino-d.one_line: Tuna, chickpeas, lettuce and tomato with a skyr dressing
steps: Drain the tuna, the chickpeas and the roasted peppers well. Rinse the chickpeas with cold water and dry them.
In a bowl, mix the skyr, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper into a smooth cream. If it is too thick, add a tablespoon of water.
Wash the lettuce and tear it into pieces. Cut the roasted peppers into strips.
Divide the lettuce between two containers. Top with the chickpeas, the flaked tuna and the peppers.
Keep the dressing apart in a small jar. Pour it on just before eating and mix. Eat it cold, or warm it in the microwave without the dressing.
ensalada-de-atun-y-garbanzos-con-alino-d.craving: Tuna and chickpea salad with a skyr dressing.

ensalada-de-pasta-integral-atun-y-rucula.title: Whole wheat pasta salad with tuna and arugula
ensalada-de-pasta-integral-atun-y-rucula.idea_name: Tuna and egg salad with yogurt
steps: Cook the whole wheat pasta in salted water for about 10 minutes. Drain and cool it under the tap.
Drain the cans of tuna well.
Mix the cold pasta with the vinegar, the dried parsley and the pepper.
Divide the pasta between two containers and put the flaked tuna on top.
Keep the arugula apart and add it just before eating so it does not wilt. The rest can be heated in the microwave without the arugula.
ensalada-de-pasta-integral-atun-y-rucula.craving: A salad with parsley, canned tuna and arugula.

frittata-de-atun-con-verduras.title: Tuna frittata with vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 180 degrees with top and bottom heat.
Cut the 1000 g of zucchini, the pepper and the onion into small cubes.
Saute the vegetables in an ovenproof pan with the oil for 10 minutes, until they soften and release their water. Let them cool for 2 minutes.
Beat the 20 eggs with the salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Drain the 4 cans of tuna and flake the tuna. Mix it with the vegetables.
Pour the beaten eggs over the vegetables and tuna, and spread them evenly.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until the center is set and the top is golden.
Let it cool 10 minutes and cut it into 4 equal portions.
Store each portion in a container. To eat, heat it 1 minute in the microwave at work.

lentejas-estofadas-clasicas-con-garbanzo.title: Classic lentil stew with chickpeas and chicken
lentejas-estofadas-clasicas-con-garbanzo.one_line: Lentil and chickpea stew with carrot, onion, tomato and red pepper. A vegetarian base that pairs with yogurt or eggs for more protein.
steps: Dice the onion, red pepper, carrot and garlic small. Cut the chicken breast into 2 cm cubes.
In a large pot, heat the oil and fry the onion, garlic and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the chicken and brown it for 4 minutes.
Add the paprika, cumin and salt. Stir for 30 seconds, then add the crushed tomato and the carrot.
Add the dry lentils (no soaking), the textured soy and water to 3 fingers above them. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and cook covered for 30 minutes, stirring now and then. Add water if it gets dry.
Drain the cooked chickpeas, add them and cook 10 more minutes, until the lentils are tender. Taste and add salt if needed.
Let it cool and divide it into 8 containers. Keep 3 in the fridge for the first days and freeze the rest. Reheat in the microwave at work.
lentejas-estofadas-clasicas-con-garbanzo.craving: Lentil stew with vegetables for the whole week.

pechuga-de-pollo-al-curry-suave-con-arro.title: Mild chicken breast curry with rice
pechuga-de-pollo-al-curry-suave-con-arro.idea_name: Mild chicken breast curry with basmati rice
steps: Cut the chicken breast into 2 cm cubes and the onion into small pieces. Salt the chicken.
Cook the rice in salted water for about 12 minutes, drain it and set it aside.
In a non-stick pan with a splash of water, cook the onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken, the curry powder and the garlic powder. Cook 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until the chicken is cooked through.
Turn off the heat and let it cool 1 minute. Mix the skyr with a little cooking water to make the sauce, add it to the chicken and stir without boiling.
Divide the rice and the chicken curry into 4 containers. It keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheats in the microwave at work.

pollo-al-horno-con-calabacin-y-naranja.title: Oven-baked chicken with zucchini and orange
pollo-al-horno-con-calabacin-y-naranja.idea_name: Oven-baked chicken with zucchini and orange
pollo-al-horno-con-calabacin-y-naranja.craving: Oven-baked chicken with vegetables and fruit, for the whole week.

pollo-asado-con-patatas-al-horno.title: Roast chicken with roast potatoes
pollo-asado-con-patatas-al-horno.one_line: Roast chicken breast with crispy potatoes, a classic recipe with plenty of protein.

carrot-cake-overnight-oats-with-berries.craving: Overnight oats with vanilla whey isolate protein powder (30 g scoop), oats and chia seeds. High fiber, high protein, high volume. I already have the protein powder, so leave it out of the budget.
carrot-cake-overnight-oats-with-berries.changes: Add some berries: fresh strawberries plus frozen blueberries, no other frozen berries or blackberries.

chicken-salad-with-sweet-potato-walnuts-.craving: A chicken salad with sweet potato, pomegranate seeds, apple, peas, pecans, chicken breast and feta cheese, with a honey mustard and Greek yogurt dressing.

korean-beef-bowl-with-peas-and-brown-ric.craving: Beef with peas and rice for meal prep: high protein, budget friendly, high fiber. Brown rice mixed with quinoa and lentils adds fiber and protein. About 450 calories and 40+ g of protein. Other grain mixes that add protein and fiber are welcome.

tuna-artichoke-whole-wheat-pasta-salad.craving: Take my saved tuna artichoke salad and add whole wheat pasta, then adjust the recipe to meet my macros.
tuna-artichoke-whole-wheat-pasta-salad.changes: No yogurt dressing; add parsley and feta cheese. Spinach can replace the arugula. 7 servings from 5 cans of tuna (130 g each).
